checkpoints.description: [1/5] Scaffold the probe project: README, test command, .gitignore, project memory.

impact_assessment.why: New AIKit-managed project to test this agent's capabilities end to end with a falsifiable, inspectable battery of environment checks and verifiable reports.
impact_assessment.benefits: Proves the environment's tooling works (filesystem, shell, git, imports, timing, web) with measured evidence instead of assumptions; gives a reusable capability self-test for any AIKit-integrated agent.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: probe exits non-zero when any check fails so the gate stays honest; dependency: none beyond the standard library, which the imports scan proves; concurrency: none, a battery run is sequential; state: reports/ is gitignored, the fs check writes and deletes reports/.fs-roundtrip.txt, the web fetch is read-only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Every check is falsifiable (read-back, exit code, digest, budget verified); the web check is opt-in so the default run stays fast and offline-safe.

checkpoints.description: [2/5] Add probe.py: the CLI with the default battery (fs, shell, git, imports), the deep lane (timing, web) and the JSON report writer.
[3/5] Add unit and CLI integration tests for the battery (11 tests, all green).
[4/5] Gates pass: aikit check probe 5/5 (hygiene, guidelines, secrets, compat, test); ADR-001 recorded; README tree complete.
Gates passed: aikit check probe 5/5; brand candidates and media register committed.
